notes.title: Devlog: The Music of Grave Seasons
notes.content: [p]Howdy y'all! [/p][p][/p][p]The Perfect Garbage team is stoked to share our very FIRST behind-the-scenes devlog on the making of [b]Grave Seasons[/b]! We’re kicking things off with a look at our original soundtrack + an exclusive preview of four tracks! [/p][p][/p][quote][p]“[i]We all come from different musical backgrounds. We’re all making farming sim music, but we’re making music that we like, and that’s what’s making this soundtrack special.[/i]”  - Suvi[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Our music crew is led by Art & Audio Director Suvi Savikko and Composer Gisula, two ridiculously talented artists shaping the game’s sound.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/4a29778d5374d91e33245c3043c6b067bf3f4d55.jpg"][/img][/p][quote][p]“[i]I'm a very visual person when I'm composing. Imagine this as a story structure, right? You have the climax of it there and you have to have your little ebbs and flows. If the song is big the whole time, then you don't really feel the impact.[/i]” - Gisula[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ow5tlxhPMIs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The game’s Main Theme has been our meatiest and most difficult track to date. It was the very first piece composed and it embodies the journey of Grave Seasons, pulling on the game’s design philosophy, folklore, and story. The soundtrack has truly been a labor of love (and a dash of dread 😉), with every theme crafted to balance that cozy comfort and hidden horror.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/31260a64a177110fc62f3f864cb98f21494946ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This process has led to tons of experimentation—from nylon to steel-string guitars, layering live percussion, and blending electric and acoustic cello textures. Our Seasonal themes showcase this playfulness best, with daytime and nighttime versions split between Gisula and Suvi, offering two distinct takes on every season.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/a4c5d53229f38451329ce866a764b16adcc04bbd.png"][/img][/p][quote][p][i]“In a lot of the other tracks, it's 90-95% live, 100% live instrumentation and mostly acoustic, so that we get that really organic feel to it. I feel like we wanted to make it real and include a sense of groundedness.[/i]” - Gisula[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Organic instrumentation and Easter eggs too! How many seasonal themes can say they feature the titular season spelled out in morse code? Gisula even layered in live bird ambience recorded in beautiful Nashville—where, naturally, all birds sing in perfect key.[/p][p][/p][p]And when the sun sets on a season’s daytime theme, Suvi takes over and composes the nighttime version. She riffs on the original key or chord progression, putting a darker spin on the track and giving it an ominous personality of its own.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]“[i]You want to create the impression that things are a little less safe now…a little more ambiguous. You’re no longer in that sweet and safe farming sim territory. You’re in uncharted waters.[/i]” - Suvi[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]You can see more of the process in our video devlog below! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2GFAUMjqNcI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p]What’s up next? Stay tuned! Or join the official PG Discord or follow us on Bluesky to find out.[/p][p]Thanks for watching!![/p][p]The Perfect Garbage Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/3d24b842de2b7a0a1a9895bf35cf9723cd00c76d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for 200k wishlists!
notes.content: [p]Perfect Garbage is here to say [b]THANK YOU (AGAIN)! [/b]The support has been amazing, from the involvement in [url="https://discord.gg/3B4tT3G4SV"]our discord[/url] to sharing on social media -- we can't thank you enough![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/0fad931c6148672d206e7f7ae947c1199e4e4fd0.png"][/img][/p][p]We will keep working hard on Grave Seasons and we can't wait to show you more... and we promise, it will be soon! [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for everything. Happy [strike]Hunting[/strike] Farming![/p][p]The Perfect Garbage Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/c5ef5fa356f950b1b07bc060f4092cb18acbc87e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: SGF Trailer & Release Year!
notes.content: [p]We are [i]stoked[/i] to announce that Grave Seasons is launching in 2026 on PC and consoles! It's been a wonderful journey and we are so excited to share what we have been cooking up. [/p][p]This SGF, we had the chance to participate in the PC Gaming Showcase and show off our new gameplay trailer![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="54sXez32F6I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you've been following Grave Seasons, we hope you're excited for how much it's grown and shaped up over the year. Hinted on our steam but Grave Seasons takes the traditional mechanics you know and love in farming sims, and brings out the best (and worst) outcomes from them.[/p][p]This announcement also includes our new logo, designed by [url="https://https://charlesbae.com/grave-seasons-logo-design"]Charles Bae[/url] -- which features a little taste of the potential horrors we've got brewing. Supernatural killers, murder mysteries, the dangerous occult and a town that can't seem to let go...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/223ef1a72019d0f26771287c8d0adeb81f2cf137.png"][/img][/p][p]We also had the chance to share some behind the scenes work in the Women-Led Games Showcase! Check it out![/p][previewyoutube="NPJ3t55NeuQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thank you for the support! We look forward to sharing more soon! [/p]
